Position Summary This position is responsible for the design, implementation, operation, and maintenance of enterprise level LAN, WAN, firewall, and Wi-Fi systems across a large, multi-national, multi-site organization.

The Network Engineer will collaborate with infrastructure and application teams to ensure optimal network performance, security, and scalability, while also contributing to documentation, monitoring, and the ongoing migration of on-premises services to cloud and hybrid environments.

review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Key Responsibilities Implements and supports firewall/DMZ security infrastructure, including traffic flow troubleshooting, policy analysis and security postures Implements and supports enterprise LAN, WAN and Wi-Fi systems in a large, multi-site environment Implements and supports routing infrastructure using common routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, BGP-EVPN, VxLAN Encapsulation) Administers LAN/WAN/VLAN/802.1x, Wi-Fi, VoIP, 802.1X authentication, RADIUS, Tacacs+ IPsec Tunnels and VPN technologies Designs, implements, and supports hybrid cloud network connectivity to Microsoft Azure and/or AWS, including ExpressRoute, Azure Virtual WAN, AWS Direct Connect, and Transit Gateway architectures Manages and troubleshoots cloud-based network security groups (NSGs), virtual network peering, and cloud firewall policies Supports migration of on-premises network services to cloud and hybrid environment
